```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.MedicalRecord;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.MedicalRecordStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.MedicalRecordType;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.MedicalRecordNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.MedicalRecordUpdateException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.MedicalRecordRepository;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
public class MedicalRecordService {
    private final MedicalRecordRepository medicalRecordRepository;

    @Autowired
    public MedicalRecordService(MedicalRecordRepository medicalRecordRepository) {
        this.medicalRecordRepository = medicalRecordRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public MedicalRecordResponse createMedicalRecord(MedicalRecordRequest request) {
        MedicalRecord medicalRecord = new MedicalRecord();
        medicalRecord.setPatientId(request.getPatientId());
        medicalRecord.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
        medicalRecord.setRecordType(request.getRecordType());
        medicalRecord.setTitle(request.getTitle());
        medicalRecord.setDescription(request.getDescription());
        medicalRecord.setContent(request.getContent());
        medicalRecord.setFilePath(request.getFilePath());
        medicalRecord.setFileSize(request.getFileSize());
        medicalRecord.setFileType(request.getFileType());
        medicalRecord.setStatus(MedicalRecordStatus.ACTIVE);

        MedicalRecord saved = medicalRecordRepository.save(medicalRecord);
        return toResponse(saved);
    }

    public MedicalRecordResponse getMedicalRecordById(Long recordId) {
        MedicalRecord medicalRecord = medicalRecordRepository.findById(recordId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new MedicalRecordNotFoundException("Medical record not found with ID: " + recordId));
        return toResponse(medicalRecord);
    }

    @Transactional
    public MedicalRecordResponse updateMedicalRecord(MedicalRecordUpdateRequest request) {
        MedicalRecord medicalRecord = medicalRecordRepository.findById(request.getRecordId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new MedicalRecordNotFoundException("Medical record not found with ID: " + request.getRecordId()));

        if (medicalRecord.getStatus() == MedicalRecordStatus.ARCHIVED || medicalRecord.getStatus() == MedicalRecordStatus.DELETED) {
            throw new MedicalRecordUpdateException("Cannot update medical record with status: " + medicalRecord.getStatus());
        }

        if (request.getRecordType() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setRecordType(request.getRecordType());
        }
        if (request.getTitle() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setTitle(request.getTitle());
        }
        if (request.getDescription() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setDescription(request.getDescription());
        }
        if (request.getContent() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setContent(request.getContent());
        }
        if (request.getFilePath() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setFilePath(request.getFilePath());
        }
        if (request.getFileSize() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setFileSize(request.getFileSize());
        }
        if (request.getFileType() != null) {
            medicalRecord.setFileType(request.getFileType());
        }

        medicalRecord.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        MedicalRecord updated = medicalRecordRepository.save(medicalRecord);
        return toResponse(updated);
    }

    @Transactional
    public MedicalRecordResponse archiveMedicalRecord(Long recordId) {
        MedicalRecord medicalRecord = medicalRecordRepository.findById(recordId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new MedicalRecordNotFoundException("Medical record not found with ID: " + recordId));

        if (medicalRecord.getStatus() != MedicalRecordStatus.ACTIVE) {
            throw new MedicalRecordUpdateException("Cannot archive medical record with status: " + medicalRecord.getStatus());
        }

        medicalRecord.setStatus(MedicalRecordStatus.ARCHIVED);
        medicalRecord.setArchivedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        medicalRecord.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        MedicalRecord archived = medicalRecordRepository.save(medicalRecord);
        return toResponse(archived);
    }

    public MedicalRecordSearchResponse searchMedicalRecords(MedicalRecordSearchRequest request) {
        Sort sort = Sort.by(
                request.getSortDirection().equalsIgnoreCase("DESC") ? 
                Sort.Direction.DESC : Sort.Direction.ASC, 
                request.getSortBy()
        );
        
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(request.getPage(), request.getSize(), sort);
        
        Page<MedicalRecord> medicalRecordPage = medicalRecordRepository.searchMedicalRecords(
                request.getPatientId(),
                request.getDoctorId(),
                request.getRecordType(),
                request.getStatus(),
                request.getFromDate(),
                request.getToDate(),
                request.getTitle(),
                pageable
        );
        
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordPage.getContent()
                .stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        MedicalRecordSearchResponse response = new MedicalRecordSearchResponse();
        response.setMedicalRecords(medicalRecords);
        response.setCurrentPage(medicalRecordPage.getNumber());
        response.setTotalPages(medicalRecordPage.getTotalPages());
        response.setTotalElements(medicalRecordPage.getTotalElements());
        response.setPageSize(medicalRecordPage.getSize());
        response.setHasNext(medicalRecordPage.hasNext());
        response.setHasPrevious(medicalRecordPage.hasPrevious());
        
        return response;
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByPatient(Long patientId) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByPatientIdOrderByCreatedDateDesc(patientId);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByDoctor(Long doctorId) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByDoctorIdOrderByCreatedDateDesc(doctorId);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByType(MedicalRecordType recordType) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByRecordTypeOrderByCreatedDateDesc(recordType);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByStatus(MedicalRecordStatus status) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByStatusOrderByCreatedDateDesc(status);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndType(Long patientId, MedicalRecordType recordType) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByPatientIdAndRecordTypeOrderByCreatedDateDesc(patientId, recordType);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndStatus(Long patientId, MedicalRecordStatus status) {
        List<MedicalRecord> medicalRecords = medicalRecordRepository.findByPatientIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedDateDesc(patientId, status);
        return medicalRecords.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private MedicalRecordResponse toResponse(MedicalRecord medicalRecord) {
        MedicalRecordResponse response = new MedicalRecordResponse();
        response.setRecordId(medicalRecord.getRecordId());
        response.setPatientId(medicalRecord.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(medicalRecord.getDoctorId());
        response.setRecordType(medicalRecord.getRecordType());
        response.setStatus(medicalRecord.getStatus());
        response.setTitle(medicalRecord.getTitle());
        response.setDescription(medicalRecord.getDescription());
        response.setContent(medicalRecord.getContent());
        response.setFilePath(medicalRecord.getFilePath());
        response.setFileSize(medicalRecord.getFileSize());
        response.setFileType(medicalRecord.getFileType());
        response.setCreatedDate(medicalRecord.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(medicalRecord.getUpdatedDate());
        response.setArchivedDate(medicalRecord.getArchivedDate());
        return response;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.MedicalRecordSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.MedicalRecordStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.MedicalRecordType;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.MedicalRecordService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/medical-records")
public class MedicalRecordController {
    private final MedicalRecordService medicalRecordService;

    @Autowired
    public MedicalRecordController(MedicalRecordService medicalRecordService) {
        this.medicalRecordService = medicalRecordService;
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<MedicalRecordResponse> createMedicalRecord(@Valid @RequestBody MedicalRecordRequest request) {
        MedicalRecordResponse response = medicalRecordService.createMedicalRecord(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{recordId}")
    public ResponseEntity<MedicalRecordResponse> getMedicalRecordById(@PathVariable Long recordId) {
        MedicalRecordResponse response = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordById(recordId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @PutMapping("/update")
    public ResponseEntity<MedicalRecordResponse> updateMedicalRecord(@Valid @RequestBody MedicalRecordUpdateRequest request) {
        MedicalRecordResponse response = medicalRecordService.updateMedicalRecord(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @PutMapping("/{recordId}/archive")
    public ResponseEntity<MedicalRecordResponse> archiveMedicalRecord(@PathVariable Long recordId) {
        MedicalRecordResponse response = medicalRecordService.archiveMedicalRecord(recordId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @PostMapping("/search")
    public ResponseEntity<MedicalRecordSearchResponse> searchMedicalRecords(@Valid @RequestBody MedicalRecordSearchRequest request) {
        MedicalRecordSearchResponse response = medicalRecordService.searchMedicalRecords(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByPatient(@PathVariable Long patientId) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByPatient(patientId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }

    @GetMapping("/doctor/{doctorId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByDoctor(@PathVariable Long doctorId) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByDoctor(doctorId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }

    @GetMapping("/type/{recordType}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByType(@PathVariable MedicalRecordType recordType) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByType(recordType);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }

    @GetMapping("/status/{status}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByStatus(@PathVariable MedicalRecordStatus status) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByStatus(status);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}/type/{recordType}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndType(
            @PathVariable Long patientId, 
            @PathVariable MedicalRecordType recordType) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndType(patientId, recordType);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}/status/{status}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<MedicalRecordResponse>> getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndStatus(
            @PathVariable Long patientId, 
            @PathVariable MedicalRecordStatus status) {
        List<MedicalRecordResponse> medicalRecords = medicalRecordService.getMedicalRecordsByPatientAndStatus(patientId, status);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(medicalRecords);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.Data;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "vital_signs")
@Data
public class VitalSign {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long vitalId;

    @Column(name = "patient_id", nullable = false)
    private Long patientId;

    @Column(name = "doctor_id")
    private Long doctorId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "vital_type", nullable = false)
    private VitalType vitalType;

    @Column(name = "value", nullable = false)
    private Double value;

    @Column(name = "unit")
    private String unit;

    @Column(name = "notes")
    private String notes;

    @Column(name = "measured_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime measuredDate;

    @Column(name = "created_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @Column(name = "updated_date")
    private LocalDateTime updatedDate;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        createdDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        if (measuredDate == null) {
            measuredDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        }
    }

    @PreUpdate
    protected void onUpdate() {
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.repository;

import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalSign;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalType;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

@Repository
public interface VitalSignRepository extends JpaRepository<VitalSign, Long> {
    
    Page<VitalSign> findByPatientId(Long patientId, Pageable pageable);
    
    Page<VitalSign> findByPatientIdAndVitalType(Long patientId, VitalType vitalType, Pageable pageable);
    
    Page<VitalSign> findByPatientIdAndDoctorId(Long patientId, Long doctorId, Pageable pageable);
    
    @Query("SELECT v FROM VitalSign v WHERE v.patientId = :patientId " +
           "AND (:doctorId IS NULL OR v.doctorId = :doctorId) " +
           "AND (:vitalType IS NULL OR v.vitalType = :vitalType) " +
           "AND (:fromDate IS NULL OR v.measuredDate >= :fromDate) " +
           "AND (:toDate IS NULL OR v.measuredDate <= :toDate) " +
           "AND (:minValue IS NULL OR v.value >= :minValue) " +
           "AND (:maxValue IS NULL OR v.value <= :maxValue)")
    Page<VitalSign> searchVitalSigns(
            @Param("patientId") Long patientId,
            @Param("doctorId") Long doctorId,
            @Param("vitalType") VitalType vitalType,
            @Param("fromDate") LocalDateTime fromDate,
            @Param("toDate") LocalDateTime toDate,
            @Param("minValue") Double minValue,
            @Param("maxValue") Double maxValue,
            Pageable pageable);
    
    @Query("SELECT v FROM VitalSign v WHERE v.patientId = :patientId " +
           "AND v.vitalType = :vitalType " +
           "AND v.measuredDate >= :fromDate " +
           "ORDER BY v.measuredDate ASC")
    List<VitalSign> findTrendData(
            @Param("patientId") Long patientId,
            @Param("vitalType") VitalType vitalType,
            @Param("fromDate") LocalDateTime fromDate);
    
    @Query("SELECT AVG(v.value), MIN(v.value), MAX(v.value) FROM VitalSign v " +
           "WHERE v.patientId = :patientId AND v.vitalType = :vitalType " +
           "AND v.measuredDate >= :fromDate")
    Object[] getVitalStats(
            @Param("patientId") Long patientId,
            @Param("vitalType") VitalType vitalType,
            @Param("fromDate") LocalDateTime fromDate);
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignTrendResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalSign;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalType;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.VitalSignNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.VitalSignValidationException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.VitalSignRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class VitalSignService {
    
    private final VitalSignRepository vitalSignRepository;
    
    public VitalSignResponse createVitalSign(VitalSignRequest request) {
        validateVitalSignRequest(request);
        
        VitalSign vitalSign = new VitalSign();
        vitalSign.setPatientId(request.getPatientId());
        vitalSign.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
        vitalSign.setVitalType(request.getVitalType());
        vitalSign.setValue(request.getValue());
        vitalSign.setUnit(request.getUnit());
        vitalSign.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        vitalSign.setMeasuredDate(request.getMeasuredDate() != null ? 
            request.getMeasuredDate() : LocalDateTime.now());
        
        VitalSign savedVitalSign = vitalSignRepository.save(vitalSign);
        return mapToResponse(savedVitalSign);
    }
    
    public VitalSignResponse getVitalSign(Long vitalId) {
        VitalSign vitalSign = vitalSignRepository.findById(vitalId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new VitalSignNotFoundException(vitalId));
        return mapToResponse(vitalSign);
    }
    
    public VitalSignResponse updateVitalSign(VitalSignUpdateRequest request) {
        VitalSign vitalSign = vitalSignRepository.findById(request.getVitalId())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new VitalSignNotFoundException(request.getVitalId()));
        
        if (request.getVitalType() != null) {
            vitalSign.setVitalType(request.getVitalType());
        }
        if (request.getValue() != null) {
            validateVitalValue(request.getValue());
            vitalSign.setValue(request.getValue());
        }
        if (request.getUnit() != null) {
            vitalSign.setUnit(request.getUnit());
        }
        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            vitalSign.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        }
        if (request.getMeasuredDate() != null) {
            vitalSign.setMeasuredDate(request.getMeasuredDate());
        }
        
        VitalSign updatedVitalSign = vitalSignRepository.save(vitalSign);
        return mapToResponse(updatedVitalSign);
    }
    
    public void deleteVitalSign(Long vitalId) {
        if (!vitalSignRepository.existsById(vitalId)) {
            throw new VitalSignNotFoundException(vitalId);
        }
        vitalSignRepository.deleteById(vitalId);
    }
    
    public VitalSignSearchResponse searchVitalSigns(VitalSignSearchRequest request) {
        Sort sort = Sort.by(
            request.getSortDirection().equalsIgnoreCase("ASC") ? 
                Sort.Direction.ASC : Sort.Direction.DESC,
            request.getSortBy()
        );
        
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(request.getPage(), request.getSize(), sort);
        
        LocalDateTime fromDate = request.getFromDate() != null ? 
            request.getFromDate().atStartOfDay() : null;
        LocalDateTime toDate = request.getToDate() != null ? 
            request.getToDate().atTime(23, 59, 59) : null;
        
        Page<VitalSign> vitalSignsPage = vitalSignRepository.searchVitalSigns(
            request.getPatientId(),
            request.getDoctorId(),
            request.getVitalType(),
            fromDate,
            toDate,
            request.getMinValue(),
            request.getMaxValue(),
            pageable
        );
        
        return mapToSearchResponse(vitalSignsPage);
    }
    
    public VitalSignTrendResponse getVitalSignTrend(Long patientId, VitalType vitalType, int days) {
        LocalDateTime fromDate = LocalDateTime.now().minusDays(days);
        
        List<VitalSign> trendData = vitalSignRepository.findTrendData(patientId, vitalType, fromDate);
        
        VitalSignTrendResponse response = new VitalSignTrendResponse();
        response.setPatientId(patientId);
        response.setVitalType(vitalType);
        response.setUnit(trendData.isEmpty() ? null : trendData.get(0).getUnit());
        
        // Map trend data
        DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd");
        List<VitalSignTrendResponse.TrendPoint> trendPoints = trendData.stream()
            .map(vital -> {
                VitalSignTrendResponse.TrendPoint point = new VitalSignTrendResponse.TrendPoint();
                point.setDate(vital.getMeasuredDate().toLocalDate().format(formatter));
                point.setValue(vital.getValue());
                return point;
            })
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
        response.setTrendData(trendPoints);
        
        // Calculate statistics
        Object[] stats = vitalSignRepository.getVitalStats(patientId, vitalType, fromDate);
        if (stats[0] != null) {
            response.setAverageValue(((Number) stats[0]).doubleValue());
            response.setMinValue(((Number) stats[1]).doubleValue());
            response.setMaxValue(((Number) stats[2]).doubleValue());
        }
        
        // Determine trend direction
        if (trendPoints.size() >= 2) {
            double firstValue = trendPoints.get(0).getValue();
            double lastValue = trendPoints.get(trendPoints.size() - 1).getValue();
            double change = lastValue - firstValue;
            
            if (Math.abs(change) < 0.1) {
                response.setTrendDirection("STABLE");
            } else if (change > 0) {
                response.setTrendDirection("INCREASING");
            } else {
                response.setTrendDirection("DECREASING");
            }
        } else {
            response.setTrendDirection("INSUFFICIENT_DATA");
        }
        
        return response;
    }
    
    private void validateVitalSignRequest(VitalSignRequest request) {
        if (request.getPatientId() == null) {
            throw new VitalSignValidationException("Patient ID is required");
        }
        if (request.getVitalType() == null) {
            throw new VitalSignValidationException("Vital type is required");
        }
        validateVitalValue(request.getValue());
    }
    
    private void validateVitalValue(Double value) {
        if (value == null || value < 0) {
            throw new VitalSignValidationException("Vital value must be positive");
        }
    }
    
    private VitalSignResponse mapToResponse(VitalSign vitalSign) {
        VitalSignResponse response = new VitalSignResponse();
        response.setVitalId(vitalSign.getVitalId());
        response.setPatientId(vitalSign.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(vitalSign.getDoctorId());
        response.setVitalType(vitalSign.getVitalType());
        response.setValue(vitalSign.getValue());
        response.setUnit(vitalSign.getUnit());
        response.setNotes(vitalSign.getNotes());
        response.setMeasuredDate(vitalSign.getMeasuredDate());
        response.setCreatedDate(vitalSign.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(vitalSign.getUpdatedDate());
        return response;
    }
    
    private VitalSignSearchResponse mapToSearchResponse(Page<VitalSign> vitalSignsPage) {
        VitalSignSearchResponse response = new VitalSignSearchResponse();
        response.setVitalSigns(vitalSignsPage.getContent().stream()
            .map(this::mapToResponse)
            .collect(Collectors.toList()));
        response.setCurrentPage(vitalSignsPage.getNumber());
        response.setTotalPages(vitalSignsPage.getTotalPages());
        response.setTotalElements(vitalSignsPage.getTotalElements());
        response.setPageSize(vitalSignsPage.getSize());
        response.setHasNext(vitalSignsPage.hasNext());
        response.setHasPrevious(vitalSignsPage.hasPrevious());
        return response;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignTrendResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalType;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.VitalSignService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/vitals")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class VitalSignController {
    
    private final VitalSignService vitalSignService;
    
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignResponse> createVitalSign(@Valid @RequestBody VitalSignRequest request) {
        VitalSignResponse response = vitalSignService.createVitalSign(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/{vitalId}")
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignResponse> getVitalSign(@PathVariable Long vitalId) {
        VitalSignResponse response = vitalSignService.getVitalSign(vitalId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @PutMapping("/{vitalId}")
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignResponse> updateVitalSign(
            @PathVariable Long vitalId,
            @Valid @RequestBody VitalSignUpdateRequest request) {
        request.setVitalId(vitalId);
        VitalSignResponse response = vitalSignService.updateVitalSign(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @DeleteMapping("/{vitalId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteVitalSign(@PathVariable Long vitalId) {
        vitalSignService.deleteVitalSign(vitalId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
    
    @PostMapping("/search")
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignSearchResponse> searchVitalSigns(@RequestBody VitalSignSearchRequest request) {
        VitalSignSearchResponse response = vitalSignService.searchVitalSigns(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/trend/{patientId}/{vitalType}")
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignTrendResponse> getVitalSignTrend(
            @PathVariable Long patientId,
            @PathVariable VitalType vitalType,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        VitalSignTrendResponse response = vitalSignService.getVitalSignTrend(patientId, vitalType, days);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}")
    public ResponseEntity<VitalSignSearchResponse> getPatientVitalSigns(
            @PathVariable Long patientId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size) {
        VitalSignSearchRequest request = new VitalSignSearchRequest();
        request.setPatientId(patientId);
        request.setPage(page);
        request.setSize(size);
        request.setSortBy("measuredDate");
        request.setSortDirection("DESC");
        
        VitalSignSearchResponse response = vitalSignService.searchVitalSigns(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
}
```

```java
        assertNull(response.getAverageValue());
        assertNull(response.getMinValue());
        assertNull(response.getMaxValue());
        assertEquals("INSUFFICIENT_DATA", response.getTrendDirection());
    }
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignTrendResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.VitalSignUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.VitalType;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.VitalSignService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;

@WebMvcTest(VitalSignController.class)
class VitalSignControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockBean
    private VitalSignService vitalSignService;

    @Autowired
    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private VitalSignRequest validRequest;
    private VitalSignResponse sampleResponse;
    private VitalSignUpdateRequest updateRequest;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        validRequest = new VitalSignRequest();
        validRequest.setPatientId(1L);
        validRequest.setDoctorId(2L);
        validRequest.setVitalType(VitalType.HEART_RATE);
        validRequest.setValue(75.0);
        validRequest.setUnit("bpm");
        validRequest.setNotes("Normal heart rate");

        sampleResponse = new VitalSignResponse();
        sampleResponse.setVitalId(1L);
        sampleResponse.setPatientId(1L);
        sampleResponse.setDoctorId(2L);
        sampleResponse.setVitalType(VitalType.HEART_RATE);
        sampleResponse.setValue(75.0);
        sampleResponse.setUnit("bpm");
        sampleResponse.setNotes("Normal heart rate");
        sampleResponse.setMeasuredDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        sampleResponse.setCreatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        sampleResponse.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        updateRequest = new VitalSignUpdateRequest();
        updateRequest.setVitalId(1L);
        updateRequest.setValue(80.0);
        updateRequest.setNotes("Updated notes");
    }

    @Test
    void createVitalSign_Success() throws Exception {
        when(vitalSignService.createVitalSign(any(VitalSignRequest.class))).thenReturn(sampleResponse);

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/vitals")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(validRequest)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.vitalId").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.patientId").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.doctorId").value(2))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.vitalType").value("HEART_RATE"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.value").value(75.0))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.unit").value("bpm"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.notes").value("Normal heart rate"));

        verify(vitalSignService).createVitalSign(any(VitalSignRequest.class));
    }

    @Test
    void createVitalSign_InvalidRequest_ReturnsBadRequest() throws Exception {
        validRequest.setPatientId(null);

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/vitals")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(validRequest)))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());

        verify(vitalSignService, never()).createVitalSign(any());
    }

    @Test
    void getVitalSign_Success() throws Exception {
        when(vitalSignService.getVitalSign(1L)).thenReturn(sampleResponse);

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/vitals/1"))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.vitalId").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.patientId").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.vitalType").value("HEART_RATE"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.value").value(75.0));

        verify(vitalSignService).getVitalSign(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void updateVitalSign_Success() throws Exception {
        VitalSignResponse updatedResponse = new VitalSignResponse();
        updatedResponse.setVitalId(1L);
        updatedResponse.setPatientId(1L);
        updatedResponse.setDoctorId(2L);
        updatedResponse.setVitalType(VitalType.HEART_RATE);
        updatedResponse.setValue(80.0);
        updatedResponse.setUnit("bpm");
        updatedResponse.setNotes("Updated notes");
        updatedResponse.setMeasuredDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        updatedResponse.setCreatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        updatedResponse.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        when(vitalSignService.updateVitalSign(any(VitalSignUpdateRequest.class))).thenReturn(updatedResponse);

        mockMvc.perform(put("/api/vitals/1")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(updateRequest)))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.vitalId").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.value").value(80.0))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.notes").value("Updated notes"));

        verify(vitalSignService).updateVitalSign(any(VitalSignUpdateRequest.class));
    }

    @Test

        mockMvc.perform(delete("/api/vitals/1"))
                .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        verify(vitalSignService).deleteVitalSign(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void searchVitalSigns_Success() throws Exception {
        VitalSignSearchRequest searchRequest = new VitalSignSearchRequest();
        searchRequest.setPatientId(1L);
        searchRequest.setPage(0);
        searchRequest.setSize(10);

        VitalSignSearchResponse searchResponse = new VitalSignSearchResponse();
        searchResponse.setVitalSigns(Arrays.asList(sampleResponse));
        searchResponse.setCurrentPage(0);
        searchResponse.setTotalPages(1);

                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.totalElements").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.pageSize").value(10))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.hasNext").value(false))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.hasPrevious").value(false));

        verify(vitalSignService).searchVitalSigns(any(VitalSignSearchRequest.class));

    @Test
```

The VitalSignController tests are still failing due to CSRF and authentication issues. This is because the test security configuration was not properly picked up by Spring Boot. To fix this, I need to explicitly import a test security configuration that disables CSRF and security for these tests.

Here's what I'll do:
- Create a `TestSecurityConfig` class in the test package that disables security and CSRF.
- Use `@Import(TestSecurityConfig.class)` in the test class to ensure it's loaded.

Let me make these changes to ensure the tests pass.

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configurers.AbstractHttpConfigurer;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

@TestConfiguration
public class TestSecurityConfig {
    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http.csrf(AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable)
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth.anyRequest().permitAll());
        return http.build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.Data;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "lab_investigations")
@Data
public class LabInvestigation {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long investigationId;

    @Column(name = "patient_id", nullable = false)
    private Long patientId;

    @Column(name = "doctor_id", nullable = false)
    private Long doctorId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "test_type", nullable = false)
    private LabTestType testType;

    @Column(name = "test_name", nullable = false)
    private String testName;

    @Column(name = "description")
    private String description;

    @Column(name = "priority")
    private String priority; // LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "status", nullable = false)
    private LabInvestigationStatus status;

    @Column(name = "requested_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime requestedDate;

    @Column(name = "scheduled_date")
    private LocalDateTime scheduledDate;

    @Column(name = "completed_date")
    private LocalDateTime completedDate;

    @Column(name = "results")
    private String results;

    @Column(name = "report_url")
    private String reportUrl;

    @Column(name = "notes")
    private String notes;

    @Column(name = "cost")
    private Double cost;

    @Column(name = "created_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @Column(name = "updated_date")
    private LocalDateTime updatedDate;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        createdDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        if (requestedDate == null) {
            requestedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        }
        if (status == null) {
            status = LabInvestigationStatus.REQUESTED;
        }
    }

    @PreUpdate
    protected void onUpdate() {
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.repository;

import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigation;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigationStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabTestType;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Repository
public interface LabInvestigationRepository extends JpaRepository<LabInvestigation, Long> {
    
    Page<LabInvestigation> findByPatientId(Long patientId, Pageable pageable);
    
    Page<LabInvestigation> findByDoctorId(Long doctorId, Pageable pageable);
    
    Page<LabInvestigation> findByPatientIdAndStatus(Long patientId, LabInvestigationStatus status, Pageable pageable);
    
    Page<LabInvestigation> findByTestType(LabTestType testType, Pageable pageable);
    
    @Query("SELECT l FROM LabInvestigation l WHERE l.patientId = :patientId " +
           "AND (:doctorId IS NULL OR l.doctorId = :doctorId) " +
           "AND (:testType IS NULL OR l.testType = :testType) " +
           "AND (:status IS NULL OR l.status = :status) " +
           "AND (:priority IS NULL OR l.priority = :priority) " +
           "AND (:fromDate IS NULL OR l.requestedDate >= :fromDate) " +
           "AND (:toDate IS NULL OR l.requestedDate <= :toDate)")
    Page<LabInvestigation> searchInvestigations(
            @Param("patientId") Long patientId,
            @Param("doctorId") Long doctorId,
            @Param("testType") LabTestType testType,
            @Param("status") LabInvestigationStatus status,
            @Param("priority") String priority,
            @Param("fromDate") LocalDateTime fromDate,
            @Param("toDate") LocalDateTime toDate,
            Pageable pageable);
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigation;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigationStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationValidationException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabInvestigationRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class LabInvestigationService {
    
    private final LabInvestigationRepository labInvestigationRepository;
    
    public LabInvestigationResponse createLabInvestigation(LabInvestigationRequest request) {
        validateLabInvestigationRequest(request);
        
        LabInvestigation investigation = new LabInvestigation();
        investigation.setPatientId(request.getPatientId());
        investigation.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
        investigation.setTestType(request.getTestType());
        investigation.setTestName(request.getTestName());
        investigation.setDescription(request.getDescription());
        investigation.setPriority(request.getPriority() != null ? request.getPriority() : "MEDIUM");
        investigation.setStatus(LabInvestigationStatus.REQUESTED);
        investigation.setScheduledDate(request.getScheduledDate());
        investigation.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        investigation.setCost(request.getCost());
        
        LabInvestigation savedInvestigation = labInvestigationRepository.save(investigation);
        return mapToResponse(savedInvestigation);
    }
    
    public LabInvestigationResponse getLabInvestigation(Long investigationId) {
        LabInvestigation investigation = labInvestigationRepository.findById(investigationId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(investigationId));
        return mapToResponse(investigation);
    }
    
    public LabInvestigationResponse updateLabInvestigation(LabInvestigationUpdateRequest request) {
        LabInvestigation investigation = labInvestigationRepository.findById(request.getInvestigationId())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(request.getInvestigationId()));
        
        if (request.getTestType() != null) {
            investigation.setTestType(request.getTestType());
        }
        if (request.getTestName() != null) {
            investigation.setTestName(request.getTestName());
        }
        if (request.getDescription() != null) {
            investigation.setDescription(request.getDescription());
        }
        if (request.getPriority() != null) {
            investigation.setPriority(request.getPriority());
        }
        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
            investigation.setStatus(request.getStatus());
        }
        if (request.getScheduledDate() != null) {
            investigation.setScheduledDate(request.getScheduledDate());
        }
        if (request.getCompletedDate() != null) {
            investigation.setCompletedDate(request.getCompletedDate());
        }
        if (request.getResults() != null) {
            investigation.setResults(request.getResults());
        }
        if (request.getReportUrl() != null) {
            investigation.setReportUrl(request.getReportUrl());
        }
        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            investigation.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        }
        if (request.getCost() != null) {
            investigation.setCost(request.getCost());
        }
        
        LabInvestigation updatedInvestigation = labInvestigationRepository.save(investigation);
        return mapToResponse(updatedInvestigation);
    }
    
    public void deleteLabInvestigation(Long investigationId) {
        if (!labInvestigationRepository.existsById(investigationId)) {
            throw new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(investigationId);
        }
        labInvestigationRepository.deleteById(investigationId);
    }
    
    public LabInvestigationSearchResponse searchLabInvestigations(LabInvestigationSearchRequest request) {
        Sort sort = Sort.by(
            request.getSortDirection().equalsIgnoreCase("ASC") ? 
                Sort.Direction.ASC : Sort.Direction.DESC,
            request.getSortBy()
        );
        
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(request.getPage(), request.getSize(), sort);
        
        LocalDateTime fromDate = request.getFromDate() != null ? 
            request.getFromDate().atStartOfDay() : null;
        LocalDateTime toDate = request.getToDate() != null ? 
            request.getToDate().atTime(23, 59, 59) : null;
        
        Page<LabInvestigation> investigationsPage = labInvestigationRepository.searchInvestigations(
            request.getPatientId(),
            request.getDoctorId(),
            request.getTestType(),
            request.getStatus(),
            request.getPriority(),
            fromDate,
            toDate,
            pageable
        );
        
        return mapToSearchResponse(investigationsPage);
    }
    
    public LabInvestigationResponse updateLabInvestigationStatus(Long investigationId, LabInvestigationStatus status) {
        LabInvestigation investigation = labInvestigationRepository.findById(investigationId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(investigationId));
        
        investigation.setStatus(status);
        
        if (status == LabInvestigationStatus.COMPLETED && investigation.getCompletedDate() == null) {
            investigation.setCompletedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        }
        
        LabInvestigation updatedInvestigation = labInvestigationRepository.save(investigation);
        return mapToResponse(updatedInvestigation);
    }
    
    public LabInvestigationResponse updateLabResults(Long investigationId, String results, String reportUrl) {
        LabInvestigation investigation = labInvestigationRepository.findById(investigationId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(investigationId));
        
        investigation.setResults(results);
        investigation.setReportUrl(reportUrl);
        investigation.setStatus(LabInvestigationStatus.REPORT_READY);
        investigation.setCompletedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        
        LabInvestigation updatedInvestigation = labInvestigationRepository.save(investigation);
        return mapToResponse(updatedInvestigation);
    }
    
    private void validateLabInvestigationRequest(LabInvestigationRequest request) {
        if (request.getPatientId() == null) {
            throw new LabInvestigationValidationException("Patient ID is required");
        }
        if (request.getDoctorId() == null) {
            throw new LabInvestigationValidationException("Doctor ID is required");
        }
        if (request.getTestType() == null) {
            throw new LabInvestigationValidationException("Test type is required");
        }
        if (request.getTestName() == null || request.getTestName().trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new LabInvestigationValidationException("Test name is required");
        }
    }
    
    private LabInvestigationResponse mapToResponse(LabInvestigation investigation) {
        LabInvestigationResponse response = new LabInvestigationResponse();
        response.setInvestigationId(investigation.getInvestigationId());
        response.setPatientId(investigation.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(investigation.getDoctorId());
        response.setTestType(investigation.getTestType());
        response.setTestName(investigation.getTestName());
        response.setDescription(investigation.getDescription());
        response.setPriority(investigation.getPriority());
        response.setStatus(investigation.getStatus());
        response.setRequestedDate(investigation.getRequestedDate());
        response.setScheduledDate(investigation.getScheduledDate());
        response.setCompletedDate(investigation.getCompletedDate());
        response.setResults(investigation.getResults());
        response.setReportUrl(investigation.getReportUrl());
        response.setNotes(investigation.getNotes());
        response.setCost(investigation.getCost());
        response.setCreatedDate(investigation.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(investigation.getUpdatedDate());
        return response;
    }
    
    private LabInvestigationSearchResponse mapToSearchResponse(Page<LabInvestigation> investigationsPage) {
        LabInvestigationSearchResponse response = new LabInvestigationSearchResponse();
        response.setInvestigations(investigationsPage.getContent().stream()
            .map(this::mapToResponse)
            .collect(Collectors.toList()));
        response.setCurrentPage(investigationsPage.getNumber());
        response.setTotalPages(investigationsPage.getTotalPages());
        response.setTotalElements(investigationsPage.getTotalElements());
        response.setPageSize(investigationsPage.getSize());
        response.setHasNext(investigationsPage.hasNext());
        response.setHasPrevious(investigationsPage.hasPrevious());
        return response;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigationStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.LabInvestigationService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/labs")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class LabInvestigationController {
    
    private final LabInvestigationService labInvestigationService;
    
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationResponse> createLabInvestigation(@Valid @RequestBody LabInvestigationRequest request) {
        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/{investigationId}")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationResponse> getLabInvestigation(@PathVariable Long investigationId) {
        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.getLabInvestigation(investigationId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @PutMapping("/{investigationId}")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationResponse> updateLabInvestigation(
            @PathVariable Long investigationId,
            @Valid @RequestBody LabInvestigationUpdateRequest request) {
        request.setInvestigationId(investigationId);
        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.updateLabInvestigation(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @DeleteMapping("/{investigationId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteLabInvestigation(@PathVariable Long investigationId) {
        labInvestigationService.deleteLabInvestigation(investigationId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
    
    @PostMapping("/search")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationSearchResponse> searchLabInvestigations(@RequestBody LabInvestigationSearchRequest request) {
        LabInvestigationSearchResponse response = labInvestigationService.searchLabInvestigations(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @PutMapping("/{investigationId}/status")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationResponse> updateLabInvestigationStatus(
            @PathVariable Long investigationId,
            @RequestParam LabInvestigationStatus status) {
        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.updateLabInvestigationStatus(investigationId, status);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @PutMapping("/{investigationId}/results")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationResponse> updateLabResults(
            @PathVariable Long investigationId,
            @RequestParam String results,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String reportUrl) {
        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.updateLabResults(investigationId, results, reportUrl);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}")
    public ResponseEntity<LabInvestigationSearchResponse> getPatientLabInvestigations(
            @PathVariable Long patientId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size) {
        LabInvestigationSearchRequest request = new LabInvestigationSearchRequest();
        request.setPatientId(patientId);
        request.setPage(page);
        request.setSize(size);
        request.setSortBy("requestedDate");
        request.setSortDirection("DESC");
        
        LabInvestigationSearchResponse response = labInvestigationService.searchLabInvestigations(request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationSearchResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabInvestigationUpdateRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigation;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigationStatus;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabTestType;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationValidationException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabInvestigationRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class LabInvestigationServiceTest {

    @Mock
    private LabInvestigationRepository labInvestigationRepository;

    @InjectMocks
    private LabInvestigationService labInvestigationService;

    private LabInvestigationRequest validRequest;
    private LabInvestigation sampleInvestigation;
    private LabInvestigationUpdateRequest updateRequest;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        validRequest = new LabInvestigationRequest();
        validRequest.setPatientId(1L);
        validRequest.setDoctorId(2L);
        validRequest.setTestType(LabTestType.BLOOD_TEST);
        validRequest.setTestName("Complete Blood Count");
        validRequest.setDescription("Routine blood test");
        validRequest.setPriority("MEDIUM");
        validRequest.setNotes("Patient requested this test");

        sampleInvestigation = new LabInvestigation();
        sampleInvestigation.setInvestigationId(1L);
        sampleInvestigation.setPatientId(1L);
        sampleInvestigation.setDoctorId(2L);
        sampleInvestigation.setTestType(LabTestType.BLOOD_TEST);
        sampleInvestigation.setTestName("Complete Blood Count");
        sampleInvestigation.setDescription("Routine blood test");
        sampleInvestigation.setPriority("MEDIUM");
        sampleInvestigation.setStatus(LabInvestigationStatus.REQUESTED);
        sampleInvestigation.setRequestedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        sampleInvestigation.setNotes("Patient requested this test");
        sampleInvestigation.setCreatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        sampleInvestigation.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        updateRequest = new LabInvestigationUpdateRequest();
        updateRequest.setInvestigationId(1L);
        updateRequest.setStatus(LabInvestigationStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
        updateRequest.setNotes("Updated notes");
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_Success() {
        when(labInvestigationRepository.save(any(LabInvestigation.class))).thenReturn(sampleInvestigation);

        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(validRequest);

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertEquals(1L, response.getInvestigationId());
        assertEquals(1L, response.getPatientId());
        assertEquals(2L, response.getDoctorId());
        assertEquals(LabTestType.BLOOD_TEST, response.getTestType());
        assertEquals("Complete Blood Count", response.getTestName());
        assertEquals("Routine blood test", response.getDescription());
        assertEquals("MEDIUM", response.getPriority());
        assertEquals(LabInvestigationStatus.REQUESTED, response.getStatus());

        verify(labInvestigationRepository).save(any(LabInvestigation.class));
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_WithScheduledDate() {
        LocalDateTime scheduledDate = LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(2);
        validRequest.setScheduledDate(scheduledDate);
        when(labInvestigationRepository.save(any(LabInvestigation.class))).thenReturn(sampleInvestigation);

        LabInvestigationResponse response = labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(validRequest);

        assertNotNull(response);
        verify(labInvestigationRepository).save(any(LabInvestigation.class));
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_NullPatientId_ThrowsException() {
        validRequest.setPatientId(null);

        assertThrows(LabInvestigationValidationException.class, () -> {
            labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(validRequest);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_NullDoctorId_ThrowsException() {
        validRequest.setDoctorId(null);

        assertThrows(LabInvestigationValidationException.class, () -> {
            labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(validRequest);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_NullTestType_ThrowsException() {
        validRequest.setTestType(null);

        assertThrows(LabInvestigationValidationException.class, () -> {
            labInvestigationService.createLabInvestigation(validRequest);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void createLabInvestigation_NullTestName_ThrowsException() {
        validRequest.setTestName(null);

        assertThrows(LabInvestigationValidationException.class, () -> {
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.Data;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "lab_images")
@Data
public class LabImage {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long imageId;

    @Column(name = "investigation_id", nullable = false)
    private Long investigationId;

    @Column(name = "file_name", nullable = false)
    private String fileName;

    @Column(name = "original_file_name", nullable = false)
    private String originalFileName;

    @Column(name = "file_size")
    private Long fileSize;

    @Column(name = "content_type")
    private String contentType;

    @Column(name = "s3_key", nullable = false)
    private String s3Key;

    @Column(name = "s3_url", nullable = false)
    private String s3Url;

    @Column(name = "image_type")
    private String imageType; // X_RAY, MRI, CT_SCAN, ULTRASOUND, MICROSCOPY, OTHER

    @Column(name = "description")
    private String description;

    @Column(name = "uploaded_by")
    private Long uploadedBy;

    @Column(name = "uploaded_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime uploadedDate;

    @Column(name = "created_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @Column(name = "updated_date")
    private LocalDateTime updatedDate;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        createdDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        if (uploadedDate == null) {
            uploadedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        }
    }

    @PreUpdate
    protected void onUpdate() {
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.config;

import com.amazonaws.auth.AWSStaticCredentialsProvider;
import com.amazonaws.auth.BasicAWSCredentials;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3ClientBuilder;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

@Configuration
public class S3Config {

    @Value("${aws.access.key.id}")
    private String accessKeyId;

    @Value("${aws.secret.access.key}")
    private String secretAccessKey;

    @Value("${aws.s3.region}")
    private String region;

    @Bean
    public AmazonS3 amazonS3() {
        BasicAWSCredentials awsCredentials = new BasicAWSCredentials(accessKeyId, secretAccessKey);
        
        return AmazonS3ClientBuilder.standard()
                .withRegion(region)
                .withCredentials(new AWSStaticCredentialsProvider(awsCredentials))
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ObjectMetadata;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.PutObjectRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageUploadException;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class S3Service {

    private final AmazonS3 amazonS3;

    @Value("${aws.s3.bucket.name}")
    private String bucketName;

    @Value("${aws.s3.bucket.url}")
    private String bucketUrl;

    public String uploadFile(MultipartFile file, String folder) {
        try {
            String originalFileName = file.getOriginalFilename();
            String fileExtension = getFileExtension(originalFileName);
            String fileName = generateUniqueFileName(fileExtension);
            String s3Key = folder + "/" + fileName;

            ObjectMetadata metadata = new ObjectMetadata();
            metadata.setContentType(file.getContentType());
            metadata.setContentLength(file.getSize());

            PutObjectRequest putObjectRequest = new PutObjectRequest(bucketName, s3Key, file.getInputStream(), metadata);
            amazonS3.putObject(putObjectRequest);

            String s3Url = bucketUrl + "/" + s3Key;
            log.info("File uploaded successfully to S3: {}", s3Url);

            return s3Url;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log.error("Error uploading file to S3", e);
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Failed to upload file to S3", e);
        }
    }

    public void deleteFile(String s3Key) {
        try {
            amazonS3.deleteObject(bucketName, s3Key);
            log.info("File deleted successfully from S3: {}", s3Key);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error deleting file from S3: {}", s3Key, e);
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Failed to delete file from S3", e);
        }
    }

    public String getS3KeyFromUrl(String s3Url) {
        if (s3Url == null || !s3Url.startsWith(bucketUrl)) {
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Invalid S3 URL");
        }
        return s3Url.substring(bucketUrl.length() + 1);
    }

    private String generateUniqueFileName(String fileExtension) {
        return UUID.randomUUID().toString() + fileExtension;
    }

    private String getFileExtension(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null || !fileName.contains(".")) {
            return "";
        }
        return fileName.substring(fileName.lastIndexOf("."));
    }

    public boolean isValidImageFile(MultipartFile file) {
        String contentType = file.getContentType();
        return contentType != null && (
            contentType.startsWith("image/jpeg") ||
            contentType.startsWith("image/png") ||
            contentType.startsWith("image/gif") ||
            contentType.startsWith("image/bmp") ||
            contentType.startsWith("image/tiff") ||
            contentType.startsWith("application/dicom")
        );
    }

    public boolean isValidFileSize(MultipartFile file, long maxSizeInMB) {
        return file.getSize() <= maxSizeInMB * 1024 * 1024;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabImageResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabImage;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigation;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageUploadException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabImageRepository;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabInvestigationRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class LabImageService {

    private final LabImageRepository labImageRepository;
    private final LabInvestigationRepository labInvestigationRepository;
    private final S3Service s3Service;

    private static final long MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB = 50; // 50MB max file size

    public LabImageResponse uploadLabImage(Long investigationId, MultipartFile file, String imageType, 
                                        String description, Long uploadedBy) {
        // Validate investigation exists
        LabInvestigation investigation = labInvestigationRepository.findById(investigationId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabInvestigationNotFoundException(investigationId));

        // Validate file
        validateFile(file);

        try {
            // Upload to S3
            String s3Url = s3Service.uploadFile(file, "lab-images/" + investigationId);
            String s3Key = s3Service.getS3KeyFromUrl(s3Url);

            // Create lab image record
            LabImage labImage = new LabImage();
            labImage.setInvestigationId(investigationId);
            labImage.setFileName(file.getOriginalFilename());
            labImage.setOriginalFileName(file.getOriginalFilename());
            labImage.setFileSize(file.getSize());
            labImage.setContentType(file.getContentType());
            labImage.setS3Key(s3Key);
            labImage.setS3Url(s3Url);
            labImage.setImageType(imageType);
            labImage.setDescription(description);
            labImage.setUploadedBy(uploadedBy);

            LabImage savedImage = labImageRepository.save(labImage);
            log.info("Lab image uploaded successfully: {}", savedImage.getImageId());

            return mapToResponse(savedImage);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error uploading lab image", e);
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Failed to upload lab image", e);
        }
    }

    public LabImageResponse getLabImage(Long imageId) {
        LabImage labImage = labImageRepository.findById(imageId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabImageNotFoundException(imageId));
        return mapToResponse(labImage);
    }

    public List<LabImageResponse> getLabImagesByInvestigation(Long investigationId) {
        List<LabImage> labImages = labImageRepository.findByInvestigationId(investigationId);
        return labImages.stream()
            .map(this::mapToResponse)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public void deleteLabImage(Long imageId) {
        LabImage labImage = labImageRepository.findById(imageId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new LabImageNotFoundException(imageId));

        try {
            // Delete from S3
            s3Service.deleteFile(labImage.getS3Key());
            
            // Delete from database
            labImageRepository.deleteById(imageId);
            
            log.info("Lab image deleted successfully: {}", imageId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error deleting lab image: {}", imageId, e);
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Failed to delete lab image", e);
        }
    }

    public void deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(Long investigationId) {
        List<LabImage> labImages = labImageRepository.findByInvestigationId(investigationId);
        
        for (LabImage labImage : labImages) {
            try {
                s3Service.deleteFile(labImage.getS3Key());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Error deleting S3 file for image: {}", labImage.getImageId(), e);
            }
        }
        
        labImageRepository.deleteByInvestigationId(investigationId);
        log.info("All lab images deleted for investigation: {}", investigationId);
    }

    private void validateFile(MultipartFile file) {
        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new LabImageUploadException("File is empty or null");
        }

        if (!s3Service.isValidImageFile(file)) {
            throw new LabImageUploadException("Invalid file type. Only image files are allowed");
        }

        if (!s3Service.isValidFileSize(file, MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB)) {
            throw new LabImageUploadException("File size exceeds maximum limit of " + MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB + "MB");
        }
    }

    private LabImageResponse mapToResponse(LabImage labImage) {
        LabImageResponse response = new LabImageResponse();
        response.setImageId(labImage.getImageId());
        response.setInvestigationId(labImage.getInvestigationId());
        response.setFileName(labImage.getFileName());
        response.setOriginalFileName(labImage.getOriginalFileName());
        response.setFileSize(labImage.getFileSize());
        response.setContentType(labImage.getContentType());
        response.setS3Key(labImage.getS3Key());
        response.setS3Url(labImage.getS3Url());
        response.setImageType(labImage.getImageType());
        response.setDescription(labImage.getDescription());
        response.setUploadedBy(labImage.getUploadedBy());
        response.setUploadedDate(labImage.getUploadedDate());
        response.setCreatedDate(labImage.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(labImage.getUpdatedDate());
        return response;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabImageResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.LabImageService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/labs")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class LabImageController {

    private final LabImageService labImageService;

    @PostMapping("/{investigationId}/images")
    public ResponseEntity<LabImageResponse> uploadLabImage(
            @PathVariable Long investigationId,
            @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
            @RequestParam(value = "imageType", required = false) String imageType,
            @RequestParam(value = "description", required = false) String description,
            @RequestParam(value = "uploadedBy", required = false) Long uploadedBy) {
        
        log.info("Uploading lab image for investigation: {}", investigationId);
        
        LabImageResponse response = labImageService.uploadLabImage(
            investigationId, file, imageType, description, uploadedBy);
        
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/images/{imageId}")
    public ResponseEntity<LabImageResponse> getLabImage(@PathVariable Long imageId) {
        LabImageResponse response = labImageService.getLabImage(imageId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{investigationId}/images")
    public ResponseEntity<List<LabImageResponse>> getLabImagesByInvestigation(@PathVariable Long investigationId) {
        List<LabImageResponse> responses = labImageService.getLabImagesByInvestigation(investigationId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/images/{imageId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteLabImage(@PathVariable Long imageId) {
        labImageService.deleteLabImage(imageId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{investigationId}/images")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(@PathVariable Long investigationId) {
        labImageService.deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(investigationId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
```
