```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabImageResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabImage;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.LabInvestigation;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageUploadException;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabInvestigationNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabImageRepository;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.LabInvestigationRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class LabImageServiceTest {

    @Mock
    private LabImageRepository labImageRepository;

    @Mock
    private LabInvestigationRepository labInvestigationRepository;

    @Mock
    private S3Service s3Service;

    @InjectMocks
    private LabImageService labImageService;

    private LabInvestigation mockInvestigation;
    private LabImage mockLabImage;
    private MockMultipartFile mockFile;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        mockInvestigation = new LabInvestigation();
        mockInvestigation.setInvestigationId(1L);
        mockInvestigation.setPatientId(1L);
        mockInvestigation.setTestName("Blood Test");

        mockLabImage = new LabImage();
        mockLabImage.setImageId(1L);
        mockLabImage.setInvestigationId(1L);
        mockLabImage.setFileName("test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImage.setOriginalFileName("test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImage.setFileSize(1024L);
        mockLabImage.setContentType("image/jpeg");
        mockLabImage.setS3Key("lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImage.setS3Url("https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImage.setImageType("X_RAY");
        mockLabImage.setDescription("Test image");
        mockLabImage.setUploadedBy(1L);
        mockLabImage.setUploadedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        mockLabImage.setCreatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        mockLabImage.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        mockFile = new MockMultipartFile(
            "file",
            "test-image.jpg",
            "image/jpeg",
            "test image content".getBytes()
        );
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_Success() {
        // Given
        when(labInvestigationRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(mockInvestigation));
        when(s3Service.isValidImageFile(any())).thenReturn(true);
        when(s3Service.isValidFileSize(any(), anyLong())).thenReturn(true);
        when(s3Service.uploadFile(any(), anyString())).thenReturn("https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        when(s3Service.getS3KeyFromUrl(anyString())).thenReturn("lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        when(labImageRepository.save(any(LabImage.class))).thenReturn(mockLabImage);

        // When
        LabImageResponse response = labImageService.uploadLabImage(1L, mockFile, "X_RAY", "Test image", 1L);

        // Then
        assertNotNull(response);
        assertEquals(1L, response.getImageId());
        assertEquals(1L, response.getInvestigationId());
        assertEquals("test-image.jpg", response.getFileName());
        assertEquals("X_RAY", response.getImageType());
        assertEquals("Test image", response.getDescription());
        assertEquals(1L, response.getUploadedBy());

        verify(labInvestigationRepository).findById(1L);
        verify(s3Service).uploadFile(mockFile, "lab-images/1");
        verify(labImageRepository).save(any(LabImage.class));
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_InvestigationNotFound() {
        // Given
        when(labInvestigationRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabInvestigationNotFoundException.class, () -> {
            labImageService.uploadLabImage(1L, mockFile, "X_RAY", "Test image", 1L);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository).findById(1L);
        verifyNoInteractions(s3Service, labImageRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_InvalidFileType() {
        // Given
        when(labInvestigationRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(mockInvestigation));
        when(s3Service.isValidImageFile(any())).thenReturn(false);

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            labImageService.uploadLabImage(1L, mockFile, "X_RAY", "Test image", 1L);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository).findById(1L);
        verify(s3Service).isValidImageFile(mockFile);
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(s3Service);
        verifyNoInteractions(labImageRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_FileTooLarge() {
        // Given
        when(labInvestigationRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(mockInvestigation));
        when(s3Service.isValidImageFile(any())).thenReturn(true);
        when(s3Service.isValidFileSize(any(), anyLong())).thenReturn(false);

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            labImageService.uploadLabImage(1L, mockFile, "X_RAY", "Test image", 1L);
        });

        verify(labInvestigationRepository).findById(1L);
        verify(s3Service).isValidImageFile(mockFile);
        verify(s3Service).isValidFileSize(mockFile, 50L);
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(s3Service);
        verifyNoInteractions(labImageRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void getLabImage_Success() {
        // Given
        when(labImageRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(mockLabImage));

        // When
        LabImageResponse response = labImageService.getLabImage(1L);

        // Then
        assertNotNull(response);
        assertEquals(1L, response.getImageId());
        assertEquals(1L, response.getInvestigationId());
        assertEquals("test-image.jpg", response.getFileName());

        verify(labImageRepository).findById(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void getLabImage_NotFound() {
        // Given
        when(labImageRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageNotFoundException.class, () -> {
            labImageService.getLabImage(1L);
        });

        verify(labImageRepository).findById(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void getLabImagesByInvestigation_Success() {
        // Given
        List<LabImage> labImages = Arrays.asList(mockLabImage);
        when(labImageRepository.findByInvestigationId(1L)).thenReturn(labImages);

        // When
        List<LabImageResponse> responses = labImageService.getLabImagesByInvestigation(1L);

        // Then
        assertNotNull(responses);
        assertEquals(1, responses.size());
        assertEquals(1L, responses.get(0).getImageId());

        verify(labImageRepository).findByInvestigationId(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteLabImage_Success() {
        // Given
        when(labImageRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(mockLabImage));
        doNothing().when(s3Service).deleteFile(anyString());
        doNothing().when(labImageRepository).deleteById(1L);

        // When
        labImageService.deleteLabImage(1L);

        // Then
        verify(labImageRepository).findById(1L);
        verify(s3Service).deleteFile("lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        verify(labImageRepository).deleteById(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteLabImage_NotFound() {
        // Given
        when(labImageRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageNotFoundException.class, () -> {
            labImageService.deleteLabImage(1L);
        });

        verify(labImageRepository).findById(1L);
        verifyNoInteractions(s3Service);
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(labImageRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteLabImagesByInvestigation_Success() {
        // Given
        List<LabImage> labImages = Arrays.asList(mockLabImage);
        when(labImageRepository.findByInvestigationId(1L)).thenReturn(labImages);
        doNothing().when(s3Service).deleteFile(anyString());
        doNothing().when(labImageRepository).deleteByInvestigationId(1L);

        // When
        labImageService.deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(1L);

        // Then
        verify(labImageRepository).findByInvestigationId(1L);
        verify(s3Service).deleteFile("lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        verify(labImageRepository).deleteByInvestigationId(1L);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.LabImageResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.LabImageService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@WebMvcTest(LabImageController.class)
class LabImageControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockBean
    private LabImageService labImageService;

    @Autowired
    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private LabImageResponse mockLabImageResponse;
    private MockMultipartFile mockFile;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        mockLabImageResponse = new LabImageResponse();
        mockLabImageResponse.setImageId(1L);
        mockLabImageResponse.setInvestigationId(1L);
        mockLabImageResponse.setFileName("test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImageResponse.setOriginalFileName("test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImageResponse.setFileSize(1024L);
        mockLabImageResponse.setContentType("image/jpeg");
        mockLabImageResponse.setS3Key("lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImageResponse.setS3Url("https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg");
        mockLabImageResponse.setImageType("X_RAY");
        mockLabImageResponse.setDescription("Test image");
        mockLabImageResponse.setUploadedBy(1L);
        mockLabImageResponse.setUploadedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        mockLabImageResponse.setCreatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());
        mockLabImageResponse.setUpdatedDate(LocalDateTime.now());

        mockFile = new MockMultipartFile(
            "file",
            "test-image.jpg",
            "image/jpeg",
            "test image content".getBytes()
        );
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        when(labImageService.uploadLabImage(eq(1L), any(), eq("X_RAY"), eq("Test image"), eq(1L)))
            .thenReturn(mockLabImageResponse);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(multipart("/api/labs/1/images")
                .file(mockFile)
                .param("imageType", "X_RAY")
                .param("description", "Test image")
                .param("uploadedBy", "1"))
            .andExpect(status().isCreated())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.imageId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.investigationId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.fileName").value("test-image.jpg"))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.imageType").value("X_RAY"))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.description").value("Test image"));

        verify(labImageService).uploadLabImage(eq(1L), any(), eq("X_RAY"), eq("Test image"), eq(1L));
    }

    @Test
    void uploadLabImage_WithoutOptionalParams() throws Exception {
        // Given
        when(labImageService.uploadLabImage(eq(1L), any(), isNull(), isNull(), isNull()))
            .thenReturn(mockLabImageResponse);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(multipart("/api/labs/1/images")
                .file(mockFile))
            .andExpect(status().isCreated())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.imageId").value(1));

        verify(labImageService).uploadLabImage(eq(1L), any(), isNull(), isNull(), isNull());
    }

    @Test
    void getLabImage_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        when(labImageService.getLabImage(1L)).thenReturn(mockLabImageResponse);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/labs/images/1"))
            .andExpect(status().isOk())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.imageId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.investigationId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.fileName").value("test-image.jpg"));

        verify(labImageService).getLabImage(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void getLabImagesByInvestigation_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        List<LabImageResponse> responses = Arrays.asList(mockLabImageResponse);
        when(labImageService.getLabImagesByInvestigation(1L)).thenReturn(responses);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/labs/1/images"))
            .andExpect(status().isOk())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].imageId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].investigationId").value(1))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].fileName").value("test-image.jpg"));

        verify(labImageService).getLabImagesByInvestigation(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteLabImage_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        doNothing().when(labImageService).deleteLabImage(1L);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(delete("/api/labs/images/1"))
            .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        verify(labImageService).deleteLabImage(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteLabImagesByInvestigation_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        doNothing().when(labImageService).deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(1L);

        // When & Then
        mockMvc.perform(delete("/api/labs/1/images"))
            .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        verify(labImageService).deleteLabImagesByInvestigation(1L);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ObjectMetadata;
import com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.PutObjectRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.LabImageUploadException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class S3ServiceTest {

    @Mock
    private AmazonS3 amazonS3;

    @InjectMocks
    private S3Service s3Service;

    private MockMultipartFile mockFile;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(s3Service, "bucketName", "hms-lab-images");
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(s3Service, "bucketUrl", "https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com");
        
        mockFile = new MockMultipartFile(
            "file",
            "test-image.jpg",
            "image/jpeg",
            "test image content".getBytes()
        );
    }

    @Test
    void uploadFile_Success() throws IOException {
        // Given
        String expectedS3Url = "https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";
        when(amazonS3.putObject(any(PutObjectRequest.class))).thenReturn(null);

        // When
        String result = s3Service.uploadFile(mockFile, "lab-images/1");

        // Then
        assertNotNull(result);
        assertTrue(result.startsWith("https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/"));
        assertTrue(result.contains("lab-images/1/"));

        verify(amazonS3).putObject(any(PutObjectRequest.class));
    }

    @Test
    void uploadFile_IOException() throws IOException {
        // Given
        MockMultipartFile invalidFile = new MockMultipartFile(
            "file",
            "test-image.jpg",
            "image/jpeg",
            new ByteArrayInputStream("test".getBytes()) {
                @Override
                public int read() throws IOException {
                    throw new IOException("Simulated IO error");
                }
            }
        );

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            s3Service.uploadFile(invalidFile, "lab-images/1");
        });

        verifyNoInteractions(amazonS3);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteFile_Success() {
        // Given
        String s3Key = "lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";
        doNothing().when(amazonS3).deleteObject(anyString(), eq(s3Key));

        // When
        s3Service.deleteFile(s3Key);

        // Then
        verify(amazonS3).deleteObject("hms-lab-images", s3Key);
    }

    @Test
    void deleteFile_Exception() {
        // Given
        String s3Key = "lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";
        doThrow(new RuntimeException("S3 error")).when(amazonS3).deleteObject(anyString(), eq(s3Key));

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            s3Service.deleteFile(s3Key);
        });

        verify(amazonS3).deleteObject("hms-lab-images", s3Key);
    }

    @Test
    void getS3KeyFromUrl_Success() {
        // Given
        String s3Url = "https://hms-lab-images.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";
        String expectedKey = "lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";

        // When
        String result = s3Service.getS3KeyFromUrl(s3Url);

        // Then
        assertEquals(expectedKey, result);
    }

    @Test
    void getS3KeyFromUrl_InvalidUrl() {
        // Given
        String invalidUrl = "https://invalid-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/lab-images/1/test-image.jpg";

        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            s3Service.getS3KeyFromUrl(invalidUrl);
        });
    }

    @Test
    void getS3KeyFromUrl_NullUrl() {
        // When & Then
        assertThrows(LabImageUploadException.class, () -> {
            s3Service.getS3KeyFromUrl(null);
        });
    }

    @Test
    void isValidImageFile_ValidTypes() {
        // Given
        MockMultipartFile jpegFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.jpg", "image/jpeg", "test".getBytes());
        MockMultipartFile pngFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.png", "image/png", "test".getBytes());
        MockMultipartFile gifFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.gif", "image/gif", "test".getBytes());
        MockMultipartFile dicomFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.dcm", "application/dicom", "test".getBytes());

        // When & Then
        assertTrue(s3Service.isValidImageFile(jpegFile));
        assertTrue(s3Service.isValidImageFile(pngFile));
        assertTrue(s3Service.isValidImageFile(gifFile));
        assertTrue(s3Service.isValidImageFile(dicomFile));
    }

    @Test
    void isValidImageFile_InvalidTypes() {
        // Given
        MockMultipartFile textFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.txt", "text/plain", "test".getBytes());
        MockMultipartFile pdfFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.pdf", "application/pdf", "test".getBytes());

        // When & Then
        assertFalse(s3Service.isValidImageFile(textFile));
        assertFalse(s3Service.isValidImageFile(pdfFile));
    }

    @Test
    void isValidImageFile_NullContentType() {
        // Given
        MockMultipartFile nullContentTypeFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.jpg", null, "test".getBytes());

        // When & Then
        assertFalse(s3Service.isValidImageFile(nullContentTypeFile));
    }

    @Test
    void isValidFileSize_ValidSize() {
        // Given
        MockMultipartFile smallFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.jpg", "image/jpeg", "test".getBytes());

        // When & Then
        assertTrue(s3Service.isValidFileSize(smallFile, 50L)); // 50MB limit
    }

    @Test
    void isValidFileSize_TooLarge() {
        // Given
        byte[] largeContent = new byte[51 * 1024 * 1024]; // 51MB
        MockMultipartFile largeFile = new MockMultipartFile("file", "test.jpg", "image/jpeg", largeContent);

        // When & Then
        assertFalse(s3Service.isValidFileSize(largeFile, 50L)); // 50MB limit
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.Data;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

@Entity
@Table(name = "prescriptions")
@Data
public class Prescription {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long prescriptionId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private Long patientId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private Long doctorId;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime prescribedDate;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String diagnosis;

    @ElementCollection(fetch = FetchType.EAGER)
    @CollectionTable(name = "prescription_medications", joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "prescription_id"))
    private List<Medication> medications;

    @Column(length = 1000)
    private String notes;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @Column
    private LocalDateTime updatedDate;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        createdDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        prescribedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    @PreUpdate
    protected void onUpdate() {
        updatedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    @Embeddable
    @Data
    public static class Medication {
        private String name;
        private String dosage;
        private String frequency;
        private String duration;
        private String instructions;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.Prescription;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.PrescriptionNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.PrescriptionRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PrescriptionService {

    private final PrescriptionRepository prescriptionRepository;

    @Transactional
    public PrescriptionResponse createPrescription(PrescriptionRequest request) {
        Prescription prescription = new Prescription();
        prescription.setPatientId(request.getPatientId());
        prescription.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
        prescription.setDiagnosis(request.getDiagnosis());
        prescription.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        prescription.setMedications(request.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedication).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        Prescription saved = prescriptionRepository.save(prescription);
        return toResponse(saved);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PrescriptionResponse getPrescription(Long prescriptionId) {
        Prescription prescription = prescriptionRepository.findById(prescriptionId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId));
        return toResponse(prescription);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PrescriptionResponse> getPrescriptionsByPatient(Long patientId) {
        return prescriptionRepository.findByPatientId(patientId)
                .stream().map(this::toResponse).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PrescriptionResponse> getPrescriptionsByDoctor(Long doctorId) {
        return prescriptionRepository.findByDoctorId(doctorId)
                .stream().map(this::toResponse).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Transactional
    public PrescriptionResponse updatePrescription(Long prescriptionId, PrescriptionRequest request) {
        Prescription prescription = prescriptionRepository.findById(prescriptionId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId));
        prescription.setDiagnosis(request.getDiagnosis());
        prescription.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        prescription.setMedications(request.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedication).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        Prescription updated = prescriptionRepository.save(prescription);
        return toResponse(updated);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deletePrescription(Long prescriptionId) {
        if (!prescriptionRepository.existsById(prescriptionId)) {
            throw new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId);
        }
        prescriptionRepository.deleteById(prescriptionId);
    }

    private Prescription.Medication toMedication(PrescriptionRequest.MedicationDTO dto) {
        Prescription.Medication med = new Prescription.Medication();
        med.setName(dto.getName());
        med.setDosage(dto.getDosage());
        med.setFrequency(dto.getFrequency());
        med.setDuration(dto.getDuration());
        med.setInstructions(dto.getInstructions());
        return med;
    }

    private PrescriptionResponse toResponse(Prescription prescription) {
        PrescriptionResponse response = new PrescriptionResponse();
        response.setPrescriptionId(prescription.getPrescriptionId());
        response.setPatientId(prescription.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(prescription.getDoctorId());
        response.setDiagnosis(prescription.getDiagnosis());
        response.setNotes(prescription.getNotes());
        response.setPrescribedDate(prescription.getPrescribedDate());
        response.setCreatedDate(prescription.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(prescription.getUpdatedDate());
        response.setMedications(prescription.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedicationDTO).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        return response;
    }

    private PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO toMedicationDTO(Prescription.Medication med) {
        PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO dto = new PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO();
        dto.setName(med.getName());
        dto.setDosage(med.getDosage());
        dto.setFrequency(med.getFrequency());
        dto.setDuration(med.getDuration());
        dto.setInstructions(med.getInstructions());
        return dto;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.PrescriptionService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/prescriptions")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PrescriptionController {

    private final PrescriptionService prescriptionService;

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<PrescriptionResponse> createPrescription(@RequestBody PrescriptionRequest request) {
        PrescriptionResponse response = prescriptionService.createPrescription(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{prescriptionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<PrescriptionResponse> getPrescription(@PathVariable Long prescriptionId) {
        PrescriptionResponse response = prescriptionService.getPrescription(prescriptionId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionResponse>> getPrescriptionsByPatient(@PathVariable Long patientId) {
        List<PrescriptionResponse> responses = prescriptionService.getPrescriptionsByPatient(patientId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @GetMapping("/doctor/{doctorId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionResponse>> getPrescriptionsByDoctor(@PathVariable Long doctorId) {
        List<PrescriptionResponse> responses = prescriptionService.getPrescriptionsByDoctor(doctorId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @PutMapping("/{prescriptionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<PrescriptionResponse> updatePrescription(@PathVariable Long prescriptionId, @RequestBody PrescriptionRequest request) {
        PrescriptionResponse response = prescriptionService.updatePrescription(prescriptionId, request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{prescriptionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deletePrescription(@PathVariable Long prescriptionId) {
        prescriptionService.deletePrescription(prescriptionId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
```

```java
        // When & Then
        assertThrows(PrescriptionNotFoundException.class, () -> {

            prescriptionService.deletePrescription(1L);
        });

        verify(prescriptionRepository, never()).deleteById(any());
    }
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.config;

import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configurers.AbstractHttpConfigurer;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

@TestConfiguration
public class TestSecurityConfig {

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
            .csrf(AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable)
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth.anyRequest().permitAll());
        return http.build();
    }
}
```

```java
    private Long auditId;

    @Column(name = "prescription_id", nullable = false)
    private Long prescriptionId;

    @Column(name = "patient_id", nullable = false)

    @Column(name = "performed_by", nullable = false)
    private Long performedBy;

    @Column(name = "performed_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime performedDate;

    @Column(name = "ip_address")
    private String ipAddress;

    @Column(name = "user_agent")
    private String userAgent;

    @Column(name = "created_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdDate;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        createdDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        if (performedDate == null) {
            performedDate = LocalDateTime.now();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionAuditLogResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.Prescription;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.PrescriptionAuditActionType;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.PrescriptionAuditLog;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.PrescriptionAuditLogRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PrescriptionAuditLogService {

    private final PrescriptionAuditLogRepository auditLogRepository;

    public void logPrescriptionAction(Prescription prescription, PrescriptionAuditActionType actionType, 
                                   String actionDescription, Long performedBy, String ipAddress, String userAgent) {
        try {
            PrescriptionAuditLog auditLog = new PrescriptionAuditLog();
            auditLog.setPrescriptionId(prescription.getPrescriptionId());
            auditLog.setPatientId(prescription.getPatientId());
            auditLog.setDoctorId(prescription.getDoctorId());
            auditLog.setActionType(actionType);
            auditLog.setActionDescription(actionDescription);
            auditLog.setPerformedBy(performedBy);
            auditLog.setIpAddress(ipAddress);
            auditLog.setUserAgent(userAgent);

            auditLogRepository.save(auditLog);
            log.info("Prescription audit log created: {} for prescription: {}", actionType, prescription.getPrescriptionId());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error creating prescription audit log", e);
            // Don't throw exception to avoid affecting main business logic
        }
    }

    public List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByPrescription(Long prescriptionId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPrescriptionId(prescriptionId);
        return auditLogs.stream()
                .map(this::mapToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByPatient(Long patientId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPatientId(patientId);
        return auditLogs.stream()
                .map(this::mapToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByDoctor(Long doctorId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByDoctorId(doctorId);
        return auditLogs.stream()
                .map(this::mapToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByUser(Long performedBy) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPerformedBy(performedBy);
        return auditLogs.stream()
                .map(this::mapToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByPrescription(Long prescriptionId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPrescriptionId(prescriptionId, pageable);
        return auditLogs.map(this::mapToResponse);
    }

    public Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByPatient(Long patientId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPatientId(patientId, pageable);
        return auditLogs.map(this::mapToResponse);
    }

    public Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByDoctor(Long doctorId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByDoctorId(doctorId, pageable);
        return auditLogs.map(this::mapToResponse);
    }

    public Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByUser(Long performedBy, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPerformedBy(performedBy, pageable);
        return auditLogs.map(this::mapToResponse);
    }

    public Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> getAuditLogsByDateRange(LocalDateTime startDate, LocalDateTime endDate, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLog> auditLogs = auditLogRepository.findByPerformedDateBetween(startDate, endDate, pageable);
        return auditLogs.map(this::mapToResponse);
    }

    private PrescriptionAuditLogResponse mapToResponse(PrescriptionAuditLog auditLog) {
        PrescriptionAuditLogResponse response = new PrescriptionAuditLogResponse();
        response.setAuditId(auditLog.getAuditId());
        response.setPrescriptionId(auditLog.getPrescriptionId());
        response.setPatientId(auditLog.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(auditLog.getDoctorId());
        response.setActionType(auditLog.getActionType());
        response.setActionDescription(auditLog.getActionDescription());
        response.setPerformedBy(auditLog.getPerformedBy());
        response.setPerformedDate(auditLog.getPerformedDate());
        response.setIpAddress(auditLog.getIpAddress());
        response.setUserAgent(auditLog.getUserAgent());
        response.setCreatedDate(auditLog.getCreatedDate());
        return response;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.aspect;

import com.hms.patientservice.annotation.PrescriptionAuditLog;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.Prescription;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.PrescriptionAuditLogService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.aspectj.lang.ProceedingJoinPoint;
import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Around;
import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Aspect;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.RequestContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletRequestAttributes;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

@Aspect
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PrescriptionAuditLogAspect {

    private final PrescriptionAuditLogService auditLogService;

    @Around("@annotation(auditLog)")
    public Object logPrescriptionAction(ProceedingJoinPoint joinPoint, PrescriptionAuditLog auditLog) throws Throwable {
        Object result = joinPoint.proceed();
        
        try {
            // Extract prescription from method result
            Prescription prescription = extractPrescription(result);
            if (prescription != null) {
                // Get request information
                String ipAddress = getClientIpAddress();
                String userAgent = getUserAgent();
                
                // Get user ID from context (you might need to adjust this based on your authentication)
                Long performedBy = getCurrentUserId();
                
                auditLogService.logPrescriptionAction(
                    prescription,
                    auditLog.actionType(),
                    auditLog.description(),
                    performedBy,
                    ipAddress,
                    userAgent
                );
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error in prescription audit logging", e);
            // Don't throw exception to avoid affecting main business logic
        }
        
        return result;
    }

    private Prescription extractPrescription(Object result) {
        if (result instanceof Prescription) {
            return (Prescription) result;
        }
        // You might need to adjust this based on your service method return types
        return null;
    }

    private String getClientIpAddress() {
        try {
            ServletRequestAttributes attributes = (ServletRequestAttributes) RequestContextHolder.getRequestAttributes();
            if (attributes != null) {
                HttpServletRequest request = attributes.getRequest();
                String xForwardedFor = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");
                if (xForwardedFor != null && !xForwardedFor.isEmpty()) {
                    return xForwardedFor.split(",")[0].trim();
                }
                return request.getRemoteAddr();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not get client IP address", e);
        }
        return "unknown";
    }

    private String getUserAgent() {
        try {
            ServletRequestAttributes attributes = (ServletRequestAttributes) RequestContextHolder.getRequestAttributes();
            if (attributes != null) {
                HttpServletRequest request = attributes.getRequest();
                return request.getHeader("User-Agent");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not get user agent", e);
        }
        return "unknown";
    }

    private Long getCurrentUserId() {
        // This is a placeholder - you'll need to implement this based on your authentication system
        // For now, returning a default value
        return 1L; // Default user ID
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.service;

import com.hms.patientservice.annotation.PrescriptionAuditLog;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionRequest;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.Prescription;
import com.hms.patientservice.entity.PrescriptionAuditActionType;
import com.hms.patientservice.exception.PrescriptionNotFoundException;
import com.hms.patientservice.repository.PrescriptionRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PrescriptionService {

    private final PrescriptionRepository prescriptionRepository;

    @Transactional
    @PrescriptionAuditLog(actionType = PrescriptionAuditActionType.CREATED, description = "Prescription created")
    public PrescriptionResponse createPrescription(PrescriptionRequest request) {
        Prescription prescription = new Prescription();
        prescription.setPatientId(request.getPatientId());
        prescription.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
        prescription.setDiagnosis(request.getDiagnosis());
        prescription.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        prescription.setMedications(request.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedication).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        Prescription saved = prescriptionRepository.save(prescription);
        return toResponse(saved);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    @PrescriptionAuditLog(actionType = PrescriptionAuditActionType.VIEWED, description = "Prescription viewed")
    public PrescriptionResponse getPrescription(Long prescriptionId) {
        Prescription prescription = prescriptionRepository.findById(prescriptionId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId));
        return toResponse(prescription);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PrescriptionResponse> getPrescriptionsByPatient(Long patientId) {
        return prescriptionRepository.findByPatientId(patientId)
                .stream().map(this::toResponse).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<PrescriptionResponse> getPrescriptionsByDoctor(Long doctorId) {
        return prescriptionRepository.findByDoctorId(doctorId)
                .stream().map(this::toResponse).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Transactional
    @PrescriptionAuditLog(actionType = PrescriptionAuditActionType.UPDATED, description = "Prescription updated")
    public PrescriptionResponse updatePrescription(Long prescriptionId, PrescriptionRequest request) {
        Prescription prescription = prescriptionRepository.findById(prescriptionId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId));
        prescription.setDiagnosis(request.getDiagnosis());
        prescription.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        prescription.setMedications(request.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedication).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        Prescription updated = prescriptionRepository.save(prescription);
        return toResponse(updated);
    }

    @Transactional
    @PrescriptionAuditLog(actionType = PrescriptionAuditActionType.DELETED, description = "Prescription deleted")
    public void deletePrescription(Long prescriptionId) {
        if (!prescriptionRepository.existsById(prescriptionId)) {
            throw new PrescriptionNotFoundException(prescriptionId);
        }
        prescriptionRepository.deleteById(prescriptionId);
    }

    private Prescription.Medication toMedication(PrescriptionRequest.MedicationDTO dto) {
        Prescription.Medication med = new Prescription.Medication();
        med.setName(dto.getName());
        med.setDosage(dto.getDosage());
        med.setFrequency(dto.getFrequency());
        med.setDuration(dto.getDuration());
        med.setInstructions(dto.getInstructions());
        return med;
    }

    private PrescriptionResponse toResponse(Prescription prescription) {
        PrescriptionResponse response = new PrescriptionResponse();
        response.setPrescriptionId(prescription.getPrescriptionId());
        response.setPatientId(prescription.getPatientId());
        response.setDoctorId(prescription.getDoctorId());
        response.setDiagnosis(prescription.getDiagnosis());
        response.setNotes(prescription.getNotes());
        response.setPrescribedDate(prescription.getPrescribedDate());
        response.setCreatedDate(prescription.getCreatedDate());
        response.setUpdatedDate(prescription.getUpdatedDate());
        response.setMedications(prescription.getMedications().stream().map(this::toMedicationDTO).collect(Collectors.toList()));
        return response;
    }

    private PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO toMedicationDTO(Prescription.Medication med) {
        PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO dto = new PrescriptionResponse.MedicationDTO();
        dto.setName(med.getName());
        dto.setDosage(med.getDosage());
        dto.setFrequency(med.getFrequency());
        dto.setDuration(med.getDuration());
        dto.setInstructions(med.getInstructions());
        return dto;
    }
}
```

Now let me run the controller tests again to see if the serialization issue is fixed:


The remaining controller test failures are due to Jackson not being able to serialize Spring Data's `Page` object by default. To fix this, you should add the `spring-boot-starter-data-rest` dependency to your `pom.xml`, which brings in the necessary Jackson modules for `Page` serialization, or you can convert the `Page` to a custom DTO or a `PageImpl` with a known structure.

**Quickest fix:** Add the following dependency to your `pom.xml`:
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-rest</artifactId>
    <scope>test</scope>
</dependency>
```
This will allow your controller tests to serialize `Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>` properly.

The tests are still failing with 500 errors due to Jackson serialization of `Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>`. This is a common issue when using custom DTOs with Spring Data's `Page` in controller responses, even with the data-rest dependency.

**Best practice:** Instead of returning `Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>` directly, wrap the page content in a custom DTO for the response, or return just the `List` and pagination metadata. This avoids serialization issues and gives you more control over the API.

**Next step:**  
I will update the controller to return a custom `PagedResponse<T>` DTO for paginated endpoints, which will serialize cleanly and pass the tests.

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.dto;

import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;

import java.util.List;

@Data
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
public class PagedResponse<T> {
    private List<T> content;
    private int pageNumber;
    private int pageSize;
    private long totalElements;
    private int totalPages;
    private boolean last;
}
```

```java
package com.hms.patientservice.controller;

import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PagedResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.dto.PrescriptionAuditLogResponse;
import com.hms.patientservice.service.PrescriptionAuditLogService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/prescriptions/audit")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PrescriptionAuditLogController {

    private final PrescriptionAuditLogService auditLogService;

    @GetMapping("/prescription/{prescriptionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByPrescription(@PathVariable Long prescriptionId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> responses = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByPrescription(prescriptionId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @GetMapping("/prescription/{prescriptionId}/page")
    public ResponseEntity<PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByPrescription(
            @PathVariable Long prescriptionId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByPrescription(prescriptionId, pageable);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toPagedResponse(page));
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByPatient(@PathVariable Long patientId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> responses = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByPatient(patientId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @GetMapping("/patient/{patientId}/page")
    public ResponseEntity<PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByPatient(
            @PathVariable Long patientId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByPatient(patientId, pageable);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toPagedResponse(page));
    }

    @GetMapping("/doctor/{doctorId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByDoctor(@PathVariable Long doctorId) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> responses = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByDoctor(doctorId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @GetMapping("/doctor/{doctorId}/page")
    public ResponseEntity<PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByDoctor(
            @PathVariable Long doctorId, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByDoctor(doctorId, pageable);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toPagedResponse(page));
    }

    @GetMapping("/user/{performedBy}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByUser(@PathVariable Long performedBy) {
        List<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> responses = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByUser(performedBy);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(responses);
    }

    @GetMapping("/user/{performedBy}/page")
    public ResponseEntity<PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByUser(
            @PathVariable Long performedBy, Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByUser(performedBy, pageable);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toPagedResponse(page));
    }

    @GetMapping("/daterange")
    public ResponseEntity<PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse>> getAuditLogsByDateRange(
            @RequestParam LocalDateTime startDate,
            @RequestParam LocalDateTime endDate,
            Pageable pageable) {
        Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page = auditLogService.getAuditLogsByDateRange(startDate, endDate, pageable);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toPagedResponse(page));
    }

    private PagedResponse<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> toPagedResponse(Page<PrescriptionAuditLogResponse> page) {
        return new PagedResponse<>(
            page.getContent(),
            page.getNumber(),
            page.getSize(),
            page.getTotalElements(),
            page.getTotalPages(),
            page.isLast()
        );
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.notificationservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "notifications")
public class Notification {
    
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;
    
    @NotNull
    @Column(name = "user_id", nullable = false)
    private Long userId;
    
    @NotBlank
    @Column(name = "title", nullable = false, length = 255)
    private String title;
    
    @Column(name = "message", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String message;
    
    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "type", nullable = false)
    private NotificationType type;
    
    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "priority", nullable = false)
    private NotificationPriority priority;
    
    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "status", nullable = false)
    private NotificationStatus status;
    
    @Column(name = "related_entity_type", length = 50)
    private String relatedEntityType;
    
    @Column(name = "related_entity_id")
    private Long relatedEntityId;
    
    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;
    
    @Column(name = "read_at")
    private LocalDateTime readAt;
    
    @Column(name = "expires_at")
    private LocalDateTime expiresAt;
    
    // Constructors
    public Notification() {}
    
    public Notification(Long userId, String title, String message, NotificationType type, 
                       NotificationPriority priority, String relatedEntityType, Long relatedEntityId) {
        this.userId = userId;
        this.title = title;
        this.message = message;
        this.type = type;
        this.priority = priority;
        this.status = NotificationStatus.UNREAD;
        this.relatedEntityType = relatedEntityType;
        this.relatedEntityId = relatedEntityId;
        this.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    // Getters and Setters
    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }
    
    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }
    
    public Long getUserId() {
        return userId;
    }
    
    public void setUserId(Long userId) {
        this.userId = userId;
    }
    
    public String getTitle() {
        return title;
    }
    
    public void setTitle(String title) {
        this.title = title;
    }
    
    public String getMessage() {
        return message;
    }
    
    public void setMessage(String message) {
        this.message = message;
    }
    
    public NotificationType getType() {
        return type;
    }
    
    public void setType(NotificationType type) {
        this.type = type;
    }
    
    public NotificationPriority getPriority() {
        return priority;
    }
    
    public void setPriority(NotificationPriority priority) {
        this.priority = priority;
    }
    
    public NotificationStatus getStatus() {
        return status;
    }
    
    public void setStatus(NotificationStatus status) {
        this.status = status;
    }
    
    public String getRelatedEntityType() {
        return relatedEntityType;
    }
    
    public void setRelatedEntityType(String relatedEntityType) {
        this.relatedEntityType = relatedEntityType;
    }
    
    public Long getRelatedEntityId() {
        return relatedEntityId;
    }
    
    public void setRelatedEntityId(Long relatedEntityId) {
        this.relatedEntityId = relatedEntityId;
    }
    
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }
    
    public void setCreatedAt(LocalDateTime createdAt) {
        this.createdAt = createdAt;
    }
    
    public LocalDateTime getReadAt() {
        return readAt;
    }
    
    public void setReadAt(LocalDateTime readAt) {
        this.readAt = readAt;
    }
    
    public LocalDateTime getExpiresAt() {
        return expiresAt;
    }
    
    public void setExpiresAt(LocalDateTime expiresAt) {
        this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
    }
    
    // Business methods
    public void markAsRead() {
        this.status = NotificationStatus.READ;
        this.readAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    public boolean isExpired() {
        return expiresAt != null && LocalDateTime.now().isAfter(expiresAt);
    }
    
    public boolean isUnread() {
        return status == NotificationStatus.UNREAD;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.notificationservice.repository;

import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.Notification;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.NotificationStatus;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.NotificationType;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

@Repository
public interface NotificationRepository extends JpaRepository<Notification, Long> {
    
    // Find notifications by user ID with pagination
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find notifications by user ID and status
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, NotificationStatus status, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find notifications by user ID and type
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdAndTypeOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, NotificationType type, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find unread notifications count for user
    long countByUserIdAndStatus(Long userId, NotificationStatus status);
    
    // Find notifications by user ID and priority
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdAndPriorityOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, String priority, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find notifications created after a specific date
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdAndCreatedAtAfterOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, LocalDateTime after, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find notifications by user ID with custom filters
    @Query("SELECT n FROM Notification n WHERE n.userId = :userId " +
           "AND (:status IS NULL OR n.status = :status) " +
           "AND (:type IS NULL OR n.type = :type) " +
           "AND (:priority IS NULL OR n.priority = :priority) " +
           "AND (n.expiresAt IS NULL OR n.expiresAt > :now) " +
           "ORDER BY n.createdAt DESC")
    Page<Notification> findByUserIdWithFilters(
            @Param("userId") Long userId,
            @Param("status") NotificationStatus status,
            @Param("type") NotificationType type,
            @Param("priority") String priority,
            @Param("now") LocalDateTime now,
            Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find notifications by related entity
    List<Notification> findByRelatedEntityTypeAndRelatedEntityIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(String entityType, Long entityId);
    
    // Delete expired notifications
    @Query("DELETE FROM Notification n WHERE n.expiresAt IS NOT NULL AND n.expiresAt < :now")
    void deleteExpiredNotifications(@Param("now") LocalDateTime now);
    
    // Find notifications for multiple users (for batch operations)
    List<Notification> findByUserIdInAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(List<Long> userIds, NotificationStatus status);
}
```

```java
package com.hms.notificationservice.service;

import com.hms.notificationservice.dto.NotificationListResponse;
import com.hms.notificationservice.dto.NotificationResponse;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.Notification;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.NotificationPriority;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.NotificationStatus;
import com.hms.notificationservice.entity.NotificationType;
import com.hms.notificationservice.exception.NotificationNotFoundException;
import com.hms.notificationservice.repository.NotificationRepository;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@Transactional
public class NotificationService {
    
    @Autowired
    private NotificationRepository notificationRepository;
    
    /**
     * Get notifications for a user with filtering and pagination
     */
    public NotificationListResponse getUserNotifications(Long userId, int page, int size, 
                                                     NotificationStatus status, NotificationType type, 
                                                     String priority) {
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(page, size);
        
        // Get filtered notifications
        Page<Notification> notificationPage = notificationRepository.findByUserIdWithFilters(
                userId, status, type, priority, LocalDateTime.now(), pageable);
        
        // Get unread count
        long unreadCount = notificationRepository.countByUserIdAndStatus(userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD);
        
        // Convert to DTOs
        List<NotificationResponse> notifications = notificationPage.getContent().stream()
                .map(this::convertToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        return new NotificationListResponse(
                notifications,
                (int) notificationPage.getTotalElements(),
                notificationPage.getTotalPages(),
                page,
                size,
                unreadCount
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Get all notifications for a user (simplified version)
     */
    public NotificationListResponse getAllUserNotifications(Long userId, int page, int size) {
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(page, size);
        Page<Notification> notificationPage = notificationRepository.findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(userId, pageable);
        
        long unreadCount = notificationRepository.countByUserIdAndStatus(userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD);
        
        List<NotificationResponse> notifications = notificationPage.getContent().stream()
                .map(this::convertToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        return new NotificationListResponse(
                notifications,
                (int) notificationPage.getTotalElements(),
                notificationPage.getTotalPages(),
                page,
                size,
                unreadCount
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Get unread notifications for a user
     */
    public NotificationListResponse getUnreadNotifications(Long userId, int page, int size) {
        Pageable pageable = PageRequest.of(page, size);
        Page<Notification> notificationPage = notificationRepository.findByUserIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD, pageable);
        
        long unreadCount = notificationRepository.countByUserIdAndStatus(userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD);
        
        List<NotificationResponse> notifications = notificationPage.getContent().stream()
                .map(this::convertToResponse)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        return new NotificationListResponse(
                notifications,
                (int) notificationPage.getTotalElements(),
                notificationPage.getTotalPages(),
                page,
                size,
                unreadCount
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Mark a notification as read
     */
    public NotificationResponse markAsRead(Long notificationId, Long userId) {
        Notification notification = notificationRepository.findById(notificationId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new NotificationNotFoundException(notificationId));
        
        // Verify the notification belongs to the user
        if (!notification.getUserId().equals(userId)) {
            throw new NotificationNotFoundException("Notification does not belong to user: " + userId);
        }
        
        notification.markAsRead();
        Notification savedNotification = notificationRepository.save(notification);
        
        return convertToResponse(savedNotification);
    }
    
    /**
     * Mark all notifications as read for a user
     */
    public void markAllAsRead(Long userId) {
        List<Notification> unreadNotifications = notificationRepository
                .findByUserIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD, PageRequest.of(0, 1000))
                .getContent();
        
        unreadNotifications.forEach(Notification::markAsRead);
        notificationRepository.saveAll(unreadNotifications);
    }
    
    /**
     * Get notification by ID
     */
    public NotificationResponse getNotificationById(Long notificationId, Long userId) {
        Notification notification = notificationRepository.findById(notificationId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new NotificationNotFoundException(notificationId));
        
        // Verify the notification belongs to the user
        if (!notification.getUserId().equals(userId)) {
            throw new NotificationNotFoundException("Notification does not belong to user: " + userId);
        }
        
        return convertToResponse(notification);
    }
    
    /**
     * Get unread count for a user
     */
    public long getUnreadCount(Long userId) {
        return notificationRepository.countByUserIdAndStatus(userId, NotificationStatus.UNREAD);
    }
    
    /**
     * Create a new notification (for internal use)
     */
    public NotificationResponse createNotification(Long userId, String title, String message,
                                                NotificationType type, NotificationPriority priority,
                                                String relatedEntityType, Long relatedEntityId) {
        Notification notification = new Notification(userId, title, message, type, priority, 
                                                  relatedEntityType, relatedEntityId);
        Notification savedNotification = notificationRepository.save(notification);
        return convertToResponse(savedNotification);
    }
    
    /**
     * Clean up expired notifications
     */
    public void cleanupExpiredNotifications() {
        notificationRepository.deleteExpiredNotifications(LocalDateTime.now());
    }
    
    /**
     * Convert Notification entity to NotificationResponse DTO
     */
    private NotificationResponse convertToResponse(Notification notification) {
        return new NotificationResponse(
                notification.getId(),
                notification.getTitle(),
                notification.getMessage(),
                notification.getType(),
                notification.getPriority(),
                notification.getStatus(),
                notification.getRelatedEntityType(),
                notification.getRelatedEntityId(),
                notification.getCreatedAt(),
                notification.getReadAt(),
                notification.getExpiresAt()
        );
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.notificationservice.exception;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {
    
    @ExceptionHandler(NotificationNotFoundException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotificationNotFoundException(NotificationNotFoundException ex) {
        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
                HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND.value(),
                "Notification Not Found",
                ex.getMessage(),
                LocalDateTime.now()
        );
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(error);
    }
    
    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleIllegalArgumentException(IllegalArgumentException ex) {
        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
                "Invalid Request",
                ex.getMessage(),
                LocalDateTime.now()
        );
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(error);
    }
    
    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ValidationErrorResponse> handleValidationException(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex) {
        Map<String, String> errors = new HashMap<>();
        ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().forEach(error -> 
            errors.put(error.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage())
        );
        
        ValidationErrorResponse error = new ValidationErrorResponse(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
                "Validation Failed",
                "Request validation failed",
                LocalDateTime.now(),
                errors
        );
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(error);
    }
    
    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleGenericException(Exception ex) {
        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
                HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value(),
                "Internal Server Error",
                "An unexpected error occurred",
                LocalDateTime.now()
        );
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(error);
    }
    
    // Error Response Classes
    public static class ErrorResponse {
        private int status;
        private String error;
        private String message;
        private LocalDateTime timestamp;
        
        public ErrorResponse(int status, String error, String message, LocalDateTime timestamp) {
            this.status = status;
            this.error = error;
            this.message = message;
            this.timestamp = timestamp;
        }
        
        // Getters and Setters
        public int getStatus() {
            return status;
        }
        
        public void setStatus(int status) {
            this.status = status;
        }
        
        public String getError() {
            return error;
        }
        
        public void setError(String error) {
            this.error = error;
        }
        
        public String getMessage() {
            return message;
        }
        
        public void setMessage(String message) {
            this.message = message;
        }
        
        public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() {
            return timestamp;
        }
        
        public void setTimestamp(LocalDateTime timestamp) {
            this.timestamp = timestamp;
        }
    }
    
    public static class ValidationErrorResponse extends ErrorResponse {
        private Map<String, String> errors;
        
        public ValidationErrorResponse(int status, String error, String message, 
                                    LocalDateTime timestamp, Map<String, String> errors) {
            super(status, error, message, timestamp);
            this.errors = errors;
        }
        
        public Map<String, String> getErrors() {
            return errors;
        }
        
        public void setErrors(Map<String, String> errors) {
            this.errors = errors;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.hms.chatservice.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "chat_messages")
public class ChatMessage {
    
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;
    
    @NotBlank
    @Column(name = "room_id", nullable = false)
    private String roomId;
    
    @NotNull
    @Column(name = "sender_id", nullable = false)
    private Long senderId;

    }

    public LocalDateTime getReadAt() {
        return readAt;
    }
    
    public void setReadAt(LocalDateTime readAt) {
        this.readAt = readAt;
    }
    
    public LocalDateTime getDeliveredAt() {
        return deliveredAt;
    }
    
    public void setDeliveredAt(LocalDateTime deliveredAt) {
        this.deliveredAt = deliveredAt;
    }
    
    // Business methods
    public void markAsDelivered() {
        this.status = MessageStatus.DELIVERED;
        this.deliveredAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    public void markAsRead() {
        this.status = MessageStatus.READ;
        this.readAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    public boolean isFileMessage() {
        return messageType == MessageType.FILE;
    }
    
    public boolean isTextMessage() {
        return messageType == MessageType.TEXT;
    }
```

```java
package com.hms.chatservice.repository;

import com.hms.chatservice.entity.ChatMessage;
import com.hms.chatservice.entity.MessageStatus;
import com.hms.chatservice.entity.MessageType;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

@Repository
public interface ChatMessageRepository extends JpaRepository<ChatMessage, Long> {
    
    // Find messages by room ID with pagination
    Page<ChatMessage> findByRoomIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(String roomId, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages between two users
    @Query("SELECT m FROM ChatMessage m WHERE " +
           "(m.senderId = :userId1 AND m.receiverId = :userId2) OR " +
           "(m.senderId = :userId2 AND m.receiverId = :userId1) " +
           "ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC")
    Page<ChatMessage> findMessagesBetweenUsers(@Param("userId1") Long userId1, 
                                              @Param("userId2") Long userId2, 
                                              Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find unread messages for a user
    @Query("SELECT m FROM ChatMessage m WHERE m.receiverId = :userId AND m.status != 'READ' " +
           "ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC")
    List<ChatMessage> findUnreadMessagesForUser(@Param("userId") Long userId);
    
    // Find messages by sender
    Page<ChatMessage> findBySenderIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long senderId, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages by receiver
    Page<ChatMessage> findByReceiverIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long receiverId, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages by type
    Page<ChatMessage> findByMessageTypeOrderByCreatedAtDesc(MessageType messageType, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages by status
    Page<ChatMessage> findByStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(MessageStatus status, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages created after a specific date
    Page<ChatMessage> findByCreatedAtAfterOrderByCreatedAtDesc(LocalDateTime after, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Count unread messages for a user
    long countByReceiverIdAndStatusNot(Long receiverId, MessageStatus status);
    
    // Find messages by room ID and message type
    Page<ChatMessage> findByRoomIdAndMessageTypeOrderByCreatedAtDesc(String roomId, 
                                                                     MessageType messageType, 
                                                                     Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages by room ID and status
    Page<ChatMessage> findByRoomIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(String roomId, 
                                                               MessageStatus status, 
                                                               Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages with custom filters
    @Query("SELECT m FROM ChatMessage m WHERE m.roomId = :roomId " +
           "AND (:messageType IS NULL OR m.messageType = :messageType) " +
           "AND (:status IS NULL OR m.status = :status) " +
           "AND (:senderId IS NULL OR m.senderId = :senderId) " +
           "ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC")
    Page<ChatMessage> findByRoomIdWithFilters(@Param("roomId") String roomId,
                                             @Param("messageType") MessageType messageType,
                                             @Param("status") MessageStatus status,
                                             @Param("senderId") Long senderId,
                                             Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find file messages by room ID
    @Query("SELECT m FROM ChatMessage m WHERE m.roomId = :roomId AND m.messageType IN ('FILE', 'IMAGE', 'AUDIO', 'VIDEO', 'DOCUMENT') " +
           "ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC")
    Page<ChatMessage> findFileMessagesByRoomId(@Param("roomId") String roomId, Pageable pageable);
    
    // Find messages by room ID and date range
    @Query("SELECT m FROM ChatMessage m WHERE m.roomId = :roomId " +
           "AND m.createdAt BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate " +
           "ORDER BY m.createdAt DESC")
    Page<ChatMessage> findByRoomIdAndDateRange(@Param("roomId") String roomId,
                                               @Param("startDate") LocalDateTime startDate,
                                               @Param("endDate") LocalDateTime endDate,
                                               Pageable pageable);
}
```
